text: are u just reasserting what im saying without just making the change again. theres nothing to discuss here
resolution: Moved the Agent Seat NOTICE receiver from ModelView into always-mounted AppFrame. A model-less editor now answers look immediately with a structured no-live-model result; new creates the first real model through the shell and delays completion until its mesh-capable ModelView is mounted; other mesh verbs reject cleanly. ModelView now only publishes the current mesh-capable Seat and a UI refresh hook. Preserved per-row generation guards and batch cadence at the shell boundary, including batches that begin with new. Verified the exact live failure path no longer times out, added a model-less bootstrap test, passed all 40 Seat tests, bundled the editor, passed diff checks, and completed a ReleaseFast editor ship.
